title: Langostino Bisque
description: Sweet langostino tails add lobster-like flavor to this restaurant-worthy bisque made with pureed vegetables and Marsala wine.
ingredients: 0.5 cup coarsely chopped celery with leaves
0.5 cup coarsely chopped red bell pepper
0.5 teaspoon ground Aleppo pepper, or more to taste
0.25 teaspoon salt, or more to taste
1 (12 ounce) package frozen pre-cooked langostinos (such as Trader Joe's®), thawed, divided

steps.text: Melt butter in a soup pot over medium heat. Add onion and sauté until translucent, 3 to 5 minutes. Add bone broth, clam juice, mushrooms, celery, carrots, bell pepper, 1/2 teaspoon Aleppo pepper, 1/4 teaspoon salt, and black pepper. Stir in 1/3 of the langostino tails; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Remove from the heat and use an immersion blender to puree until smooth. Add cream, Marsala wine, and remaining langostino tails.
Return to the stove over low and heat until flavors have blended, about 5 minutes; do not boil.
Taste and season as needed with salt and Aleppo pepper.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with croutons.
